answer_1.quote: GIT and BLIP were fine-tuned for image-captioning separately on each of the different Impressions data types (description, perception, aesthetic evaluation).

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation Table displays the BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE scores for each of these models.
